description: This is a Java class defining a SplashScreen activity for an Android application. It displays a splash screen for 4 seconds and then navigates to the HomeActivity.

classes.name: SplashScreen
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a splash screen for 4 seconds before launching the main HomeActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created. Initializes the splash screen view and removes status bar.

methods.name: splashScreen
methods.description: Sets a delay of 4 seconds, then starts the HomeActivity and finishes the splash screen activity.
